admission_apply.text: You blow. Silence comes first, exact as a receipt, and the note follows it out of order.

native.admission_inspect: A pale reed split for a bard. The grain runs to the mouth, so the note must arrive before the breath.
apply_texts: Blown backward, the note is the silence counted once. Counting it twice would make it shorter, so you stop.
Last breath in. It leaves by the entrance. The exit is where you started, which is not a place.
Last breath the other way. It arrives where it began, one count early, and calls that punctual.
The other way gives a note that left before you began. What remains is two breaths short of a sound.
You blow into the near end. The near end sends the breath back as if it had been the instruction.
You blow the other way. The note is already gone. What remains is shorter than the breath that missed it.
You blow. Silence comes first, exact as a receipt, and the note follows it out of order.
inspect_texts: A pale reed split for a bard. The grain runs to the mouth, so the note must arrive before the breath.
Pale, split, and sure of neither. You hold the mouth end. The mouth end is the far end. It will not choose.
Read backward, the grain leaves the mouth. The note, already spent, was only the silence counted twice.
The grain has crept a fraction toward the mouth. A fraction is not a direction, yet the note would still have to arrive first.
Turned once, the label faces in. It reads OUT. The unseen face must therefore read IN. You have not turned it.
native.name: Contrary Reed
